cells.tense: You are walking out of what was shared toward what connects more deeply, and you are as far along as you have chosen to be.
cells.act: let the mind rest instead of working the problem
cells.ask: Leave the question alone one evening. Sit with what was shared and let your mind settle without working it. Notice what it settles on, and keep that.
cells.core:
You are moving away from something shared toward something that connects more deeply, and you are doing it at your own pace. The leaving is not finished, but it is real — and what makes it possible is that your mind carries both the thing you came from and the thing you are going toward without tearing. When you know that plainly, you do not have to explain the threshold to anyone; you let it be one.

That clarity is not free. A mind holding the old and the new at once gets tired from it, so give it the rest it asks for. Leave the question alone one evening: sit with what was shared and let your mind settle without working it. Whatever it settles on is what you actually connect to next.

cells.tense: You are bracing at the edge of a shared door and rehearsing the next threshold before this one has carried you through.
cells.act: make something skilled and small on the cleared ground
cells.ask: Name what the last leaving showed could not hold, then spend the week on one piece of solid work on that ground. Finish it by hand. The made thing stands as the evidence.
cells.core:
A shared door is opening and you are already standing on the far side of it in your head. You rehearse the leaving before you have made it, and the next threshold gets assembled in the air because you cannot wait for this one to finish carrying you. The leaving is real; your version of it runs past the shared meaning it depends on.

What breaks the bracing is making something on ground that is plainly solid. Name what the last leaving showed could not hold, then spend the week on one piece of solid work on that ground. Finish it by hand. The made thing will stand where an argument cannot, and you will not have to prove the leaving before you make it.

cells.tense: You crossed the threshold of shared meaning and have been standing behind it since, looking back at what you left.
cells.act: count it out and read what the numbers show
cells.ask: How many people and places have stayed in reach since the crossing? Count them, and put the count beside how many of them you have actually met again.
cells.core:
You crossed a shared threshold and have been standing at a door you already came through, looking back at what was left. The leaving happened; you have not been letting it be past. In that position the deeper connections you walked toward stay abstract — reachable in principle, not yet entered. Nothing further is required of you to earn them. What is missing is the plain account of who is still within reach, and what has happened since.

So make the count. How many people and places have stayed in reach since the crossing, and how many of them have you actually met again? Put the two numbers side by side. The gap between them is not a verdict; it is information, and it is the first thing this has told you in a while.

cells.tense: You are making the deeper connection happen by hand, and you would say the closeness is simply how things turned out.
cells.ask: At some point this week, stop adjusting for an hour — no smoothing, no closing the gap — and let what is already there hold without your help.
cells.core:
You are working the shared meaning by hand — closing the gap, holding the depth, bringing the connection along — and if anyone described it back to you, you would say the closeness is just how things turned out. The adjusting is a hand, and the hand is yours. Nothing is wrong with what it is doing; what is missing is that you are not counting it as yours.

So stop adjusting for an hour. No smoothing, no closing the gap — let what is already there hold without your help. If it still needs you when the hour is up, return to it. The unadjusted hour will show you what your work has been holding up, which is the part you have not been seeing.
cells.sheetLine: The closeness is your hand, and you file it under luck.

attempts.check: The record supports a threshold in shared meaning and a correlation between mental rest and clear self-expression, but nothing says the person has already left anyone or is avoiding anything. A reader could reasonably say the leaving was practical, not a threshold, and that quiet after hard work is not the same as refusing depths. The asks survive being wrong — they are small and reversible, and each still teaches something about where attention goes. The sentence that serves me most is 'they are refusing the deeper exchange'; the record only lets me name the hesitation, not its object.
